## Highlights since 0.10.1

- **A built-in terminal.** Open a Terminal panel across the foot of the workspace with ⌃` (or from the Panels menu): each tab is your login shell, started in the project folder, and it follows Lattice's light and dark theme and your code theme.
- **Faster, calmer loading.** Each load shows one placeholder shaped like what it is loading instead of a spinner stacked on a skeleton, and a rebuilt PDF appears sooner. pdfLaTeX builds reuse a cached preamble, and a refresh redraws only the pages that changed.
- **Preview tabs and pinning.** A quick look from the Project tree, Quick open or project search opens in an italic preview tab that the next quick look replaces; edit it or double-click its tab to keep it. Pin tabs to keep them, and when a panel runs out of room Lattice closes its least recently used tab.
- **Live preview for LuaLaTeX.** The paragraph you are typing appears in the PDF as you type, while the full build waits for a pause and runs quietly. It is on by default in LuaLaTeX projects, new blank projects now use LuaLaTeX, and it can be turned off per project.
- **Synara 1.0.7 in the Agent panel.** The bundled agent runtime moves to Synara 1.0.7, and startup no longer opens Cursor's sign-in page.

## Notable fixes

- A save no longer conflicts with your own earlier save when you type, undo and retype quickly.
- The selection toolbar stays hidden while an input method is composing.
- Panel tabs have a little more room from the panel's edges.
